prompt.zh-TW: 初陽貿易今年本期淨利 {{money:vars.ni}}（和去年一樣），年底股東權益總額 {{money:vars.equity}}；ROE 從去年的 {{percent:vars.last}} 升到今年的 {{percent:vars.now}}（見上表）。年中公司發了一筆很大的現金股利。哪一個判讀最合理？
prompt.en: First Light Trading’s profit for the period is {{money:vars.ni}} this year (the same as last year) and total equity at year end is {{money:vars.equity}}; ROE rose from {{percent:vars.last}} last year to {{percent:vars.now}} this year (see the table above). Mid-year the company paid a very large cash dividend. Which reading is most reasonable?

text.zh-TW: ROE 上升是因為分母的股東權益變小，不是賺得更多
text.en: ROE rose because equity in the denominator shrank, not because more was earned

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。分子沒變、比率上升，答案一定在分母；再看負債比率是否上升，就能確認是資本結構改變。
feedback.en: That’s right. With the numerator unchanged, a higher ratio must come from the denominator; checking whether the debt ratio rose confirms a change in capital structure.

text.zh-TW: ROE 上升代表初陽貿易的獲利能力變好了
text.en: The rise in ROE means First Light Trading has become more profitable

feedback.zh-TW: ROE 確實是獲利能力的指標，你的直覺有道理。不過題目說本期淨利沒變；比率上升只是因為大額股利讓權益變小，生意本身沒有變好。
feedback.en: ROE is indeed a profitability ratio, so the instinct is understandable. But profit for the period did not change; the ratio rose only because the large dividend shrank equity, and the business itself did not improve.

text.zh-TW: ROE 上升一定是因為今年的營收成長了
text.en: ROE must have risen because revenue grew this year

feedback.zh-TW: ROE 的分子是本期淨利，題目說它沒變；分子不變而比率上升，只可能是分母變小，和營收無關。
feedback.en: The numerator of ROE is profit for the period, which did not change; an unchanged numerator with a higher ratio can only mean a smaller denominator, nothing to do with revenue.

explanation.zh-TW: 拆解{{term:tm_0k8vegyr}}：分子{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}沒變，分母{{term:tm_y37ymj9w}}因為發股利變小。{{option:o_0hrk}}找到了分母，再看負債比率是否跟著上升就能交叉檢查；{{option:o_456y}}與{{option:o_qhm1}}都只看表面的上升。
explanation.en: Break {{term:tm_0k8vegyr}} down: the numerator, {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}, did not change, while the denominator, {{term:tm_y37ymj9w}}, shrank because of the dividend. {{option:o_0hrk}} finds the denominator, and checking whether the debt ratio rose as well cross-checks it; {{option:o_456y}} and {{option:o_qhm1}} look only at the surface rise.
